requirements.name: Real-time inventory synchronization
requirements.summary: System must maintain live stock levels across all micro-fulfillment centers to prevent overselling of perishables.

requirements.name: Automated order-to-store allocation
requirements.summary: System must instantly assign incoming orders to the nearest store with available inventory and capacity.

requirements.name: Dynamic delivery agent assignment
requirements.summary: System must match orders with gig-workers based on proximity, capacity, and assigned time slots.

requirements.name: Digital proof of delivery capture
requirements.summary: System must record and verify physical handover via digital evidence before releasing funds.

requirements.name: Automated financial settlement processing
requirements.summary: System must split transaction revenue between platform, store, and payment provider upon delivery confirmation.

requirements.name: Real-time expiry and quality alerts
requirements.summary: System must flag items nearing shelf-life limits to prioritize fulfillment or trigger removal.

requirements.name: Automated dispute ticket generation
requirements.summary: System must create and track exception records for missing items, damages, or failed deliveries.

requirements.name: Regulatory compliance status tracking
requirements.summary: System must monitor and enforce food safety and labor law adherence for all partners and agents.
